description: Plan when and how a home-service business asks customers for reviews, by trade and job type: what to say at completion, the window for the one written request (with dates when a completion date is given), the moment the customer can first judge the work, and the rules that apply, from Google Maps policy, Yelp, the FTC consumer review rule (16 CFR 465) and the TCPA for texts, each cited with an as-of date. Includes the field-experiment and survey findings the timing rests on. Informational, not legal advice.

completed_on.description: The date the job was finished, YYYY-MM-DD, to get the request window as dates.

job_type.description: One job type id from list_trades, such as water_heater, replacement or mowing, or a job class (repair, install, project, recurring, emergency, inspection). Leave out to get every job type for the trade.

trade.description: The trade: an id from list_trades (plumbing, hvac, electrical, roofing, landscaping, lawn_care, tree_service, pest_control and more) or a common name such as "plumber" or "AC repair".
